name: icd10
label: ICD-10-CM/PCS (Diagnoses & Procedures)
description: International Classification of Diseases — required on every US medical claim
short_description: WHO disease classification — required on every US medical claim since 2015
long_description: ICD-10-CM (Clinical Modification) provides 70,000+ diagnosis codes covering all diseases, injuries, symptoms, and conditions. ICD-10-PCS provides 80,000+ procedure codes for inpatient hospital procedures. Both are maintained by CMS and updated annually on October 1. The data is free from CMS with no registration required.
when_to_use: Required on all Medicare, Medicaid, and private insurance claims in the US since October 2015. Use for clinical coding systems, billing/revenue cycle management, clinical analytics, risk adjustment (HCC model), and quality measure reporting. Pair with FHIR R4 Condition/Procedure resources for complete clinical interoperability. Annual updates: https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/icd-10-codes

table_notes.icd10_code: Every ICD-10-CM code with its description, billing validity, and hierarchy position. Core table for diagnosis coding and billing. Index on code, parent_code, chapter, and is_valid_for_billing for common query patterns.
table_notes.icd10_chapter: The 22 ICD-10-CM chapters (A00-B99 Infectious diseases, C00-D49 Neoplasms, etc.). Each chapter covers a major disease category. Use for high-level analytics and report grouping.
table_notes.icd10_block: Code blocks within chapters (e.g. A00-A09 Intestinal infectious diseases). Essential for mid-level grouping in analytics dashboards.
table_notes.icd10_pcs_code: ICD-10-PCS (Procedure Coding System) codes for inpatient hospital procedures. 7-character codes with each position encoding a specific dimension (section, body system, operation, etc.). US inpatient only — outpatient uses CPT codes.

icd10_chapter.name: chapter_number
icd10_chapter.description: Roman numeral chapter number (I through XXII)

icd10_chapter.name: code_range_start
icd10_chapter.description: First code in this chapter (e.g. A00 for Infectious diseases)

icd10_chapter.name: code_range_end
icd10_chapter.description: Last code in this chapter (e.g. B99)

icd10_chapter.name: title
icd10_chapter.description: Full chapter title (e.g. Certain infectious and parasitic diseases)

icd10_chapter.name: short_title
icd10_chapter.description: Abbreviated chapter title for UI display

icd10_block.name: code_range_start
icd10_block.description: First code in this block (e.g. A00)

icd10_block.name: code_range_end
icd10_block.description: Last code in this block (e.g. A09)

icd10_code.name: code
icd10_code.description: ICD-10-CM code (3-7 chars, e.g. J18.9 or S72.001A). No dots stored — add for display.

icd10_code.name: code_with_dots
icd10_code.description: Display form with decimal point (e.g. J18.9). Used in UI and on claims forms.

icd10_code.name: short_description
icd10_code.description: CMS short description (fits on claim forms, max 60 chars)

icd10_code.name: long_description
icd10_code.description: Full CMS description with complete clinical detail

icd10_code.name: chapter_id
icd10_code.description: Chapter this code belongs to (for analytics grouping)

icd10_code.name: parent_code
icd10_code.description: Parent code in the hierarchy (e.g. J18 is parent of J18.9)

icd10_code.name: is_valid_for_billing
icd10_code.description: True = billable (leaf code). False = header code, not valid on claims.

icd10_code.name: is_header
icd10_code.description: True if this is a category header code (not directly billable)

icd10_code.name: code_type
icd10_code.description: CM = diagnosis code, PCS = procedure code

icd10_code.name: hcc_code
icd10_code.description: CMS Hierarchical Condition Category code for Medicare risk adjustment (NULL if not in HCC model)

icd10_code.name: poa_applicable
icd10_code.description: Present On Admission indicator required on inpatient claims (Y/N/U/W/1)

icd10_code.name: gender_specific
icd10_code.description: Null=any, M=male only, F=female only (some codes are sex-specific)

icd10_code.name: age_range_min
icd10_code.description: Minimum age in years for this code to be valid (NULL=no restriction)

icd10_code.name: age_range_max
icd10_code.description: Maximum age in years for this code to be valid (NULL=no restriction)

icd10_code.name: effective_date
icd10_code.description: Date this code became valid (usually October 1 of the release year)

icd10_code.name: termination_date
icd10_code.description: Date this code was retired (NULL=still active)

icd10_code.name: search_vector
icd10_code.description: PostgreSQL FTS vector over short+long description for fast keyword search

icd10_pcs_code.name: description
icd10_pcs_code.description: Full procedure description built from the 7 axial values

icd10_pcs_code.name: body_system
icd10_pcs_code.description: Position 2: Body system (e.g. B=Respiratory, H=Heart and Great Vessels)

icd10_pcs_code.name: operation
icd10_pcs_code.description: Position 3: Root operation (e.g. B=Excision, H=Insertion, R=Replacement)

icd10_pcs_code.name: body_part
icd10_pcs_code.description: Position 4: Specific body part being operated on

icd10_pcs_code.name: device
icd10_pcs_code.description: Position 6: Device left in body (Z=No Device, if applicable)

icd10_pcs_code.name: qualifier
icd10_pcs_code.description: Position 7: Qualifier specifying additional detail about the procedure

icd10_pcs_code.name: effective_date
icd10_pcs_code.description: Date this PCS code became effective (October 1 of release year)

icd10_pcs_code.name: termination_date
icd10_pcs_code.description: Date retired (NULL=active). PCS codes change significantly each year.
